description: Molecular Adverse Outcome Pathway for [AOP 591](https://identifiers.org/aop/591), "DBDPE-induced DNA damage increase in liver leading to Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease via liver steatosis and inhibition of regeneration". title: DBDPE-induced liver DNA damage leading to non-alcoholic fatty liver disease via steatosis
